ValidationRule.description: Require Category, Sub-category, and Service Location picklist values when Tech Studio is selected for Functional Group.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR( ISPICKVAL( Status , "Closed: Customer Self-Resolved"), ISPICKVAL( Status , "Closed: Customer Unresponsive"), ISPICKVAL( Status , "Closed: Resolved") ), CC_Functional_Group__r.Name = "Tech Studio", OR( ISBLANK( TEXT( Campus__c )), ISBLANK( CC_Category__c ) , ISBLANK( CC_Sub_Category__c ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The following fields are required to close this case: Service Location, Category, and Sub-Category.
